name: Soul Keeper
primary:
The ally you aim at (or you) gains a soul keeper for 5 minutes: a small blue spirit circles them. If they would die while it lasts, the spirit spends itself to bring them back:
• Back to half health, fire and wither cleared
• A soul shield for 1 s: no damage at all
• Speed II for 1 s to get away
• Hostile mobs within 5 blocks are thrown back
Recast it to keep the spirit; it does not save from the void.
self_description: The soul keeper stays with you.
